name: Shared PC
description: Windows MDM settings in the Shared PC category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Account Model
properties.description: Configures which type of accounts are allowed to use the PC. Allowed values: 0 (only guest), 1 (domain-joined only), 2 (domain-joined and guest). If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Deletion Policy
properties.description: Configures when accounts will be deleted. Allowed values: 0 (delete immediately), 1 (delete at disk space threshold), 2 (Delete at disk space threshold and inactive threshold). If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

enum.description: Delete at disk space threshold and inactive threshold

properties.name: Disk Level Caching
properties.description: Stop deleting accounts when available disk space reaches this threshold, given as percent of total disk capacity. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Disk Level Deletion
properties.description: Accounts will start being deleted when available disk space falls below this threshold, given as percent of total disk capacity. Accounts that have been inactive the longest will be deleted first. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Enable Account Manager
properties.description: Enable the account manager for shared PC mode. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Enable Shared PC Mode
properties.description: Setting this node to "true" triggers the action to configure a device to Shared PC mode.

properties.name: Enable Shared PC Mode With One Drive Sync
properties.description: Setting this node to “1” triggers the action to configure a device to Shared PC mode with OneDrive sync turned on

properties.name: Inactive Threshold
properties.description: Accounts will start being deleted when they have not been logged on during the specified period, given as number of days.

properties.name: Kiosk Mode AUMID
properties.description: Specifies the AUMID of the app to use with assigned access. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Kiosk Mode User Tile Display Text
properties.description: Specifies the display text for the account shown on the sign-in screen which launches the app specified by KioskModeAUMID. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Maintenance Start Time
properties.description: Daily start time of maintenance hour. Given in minutes from midnight. Default is 0 (12am). If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Max Page File Size MB
properties.description: Maximum size of the paging file in MB. Applies only to systems with less than 32 GB storage and at least 3 GB of RAM. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Restrict Local Storage
properties.description: Restricts the user from using local storage. This node is optional. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Set Edu Policies
properties.description: Set a list of EDU policies.

properties.name: Set Power Policies
properties.description: Set a list of power policies. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Sign In On Resume
properties.description: Require signing in on waking up from sleep. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.

properties.name: Sleep Timeout
properties.description: The amount of time before the PC sleeps, giving in seconds. 0 means the PC never sleeps. Default is 5 minutes. If used, this value must be set before the action on the EnableSharedPCMode node is taken.
